The FSSI-001 composition test drives the LANDED gate (gate_admit) to GateAdmission::TangencyFree on the same box pair the packet's transverse certificate certifies, with per-side normal boxes taken as the exact Bernstein hulls of the assembled numerators over the certified boxes.
